title: Stonehead Cabbage: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Stonehead Cabbage: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Stonehead cabbage is a cabbage variety from Sakata. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Stonehead is a registered cabbage variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1970. Sakata bred it. It takes 58 to 65 days from transplanting to harvest, with 27.79 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 58 to 65 days from transplanting to harvest.
**Yield:** 27.79 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Stonehead cabbage takes 58 to 65 days from transplanting to harvest. That is about the average of the 6 cabbage varieties with a day count, 62.8 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 27.79 t/ha beats the average of its group, 21.1. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit cabbage fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [black rot of cabbage](/diseases/black-rot), [cabbage webworm](/pests/cabbage-webworm), [clubroot](/diseases/clubroot), [diamondback moth](/pests/diamondback-moth). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant Stonehead cabbage

Most repolyo comes from the highlands, where it heads well. Lowland growers need a heat tolerant hybrid and a cool month. Pick a firm head that keeps on the trip to market. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 58 to 65 days from transplanting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 27.79 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Stonehead?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
